tools.name: balanceLookup
tools.description:
Signs in to the Meridian Bank back-office app and looks up a customer account by its account number, returning that account's current balance.

Effects: mutates read, reversible yes, securityEffect none, scope single, external none, financial none, idempotent true, dataClasses PII

Credentials are not tool arguments: this server reads PASSWORD from its own environment.

accountNumber.description: The customer account number to look up, e.g. ACC-1001.

username.description: Username to sign in to the Meridian Bank back-office app with; teller1.
